endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: createHoliday
  summary: Create a new holiday in the workspace
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.holidays-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    dry_run not supported (schema rejects unknown property). Actual create succeeded.
    Cleaned up with clockify_holidays_delete immediately.
    Response shape: {id, name, workspaceId, date_period:{start_date,end_date}, occursAnnually,
    userIds, userGroupIds, everyoneIncludingNew, automaticTimeEntryCreation, projectId, taskId}.
    Requires at least one user_ids or user_group_ids entry; bare name+start_date alone may fail upstream.
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - name
            - start_date
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
              minLength: 2
              maxLength: 100
            start_date:
              type: string
              description: Range start in yyyy-MM-dd format
            end_date:
              type: string
              description: Range end in yyyy-MM-dd format; defaults to start_date
            occurs_annually:
              type: boolean
            user_ids:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
            user_group_ids:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Holiday created
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id:
                type: string
              name:
                type: string
              workspaceId:
                type: string
              date_period:
                type: object
                properties:
                  start_date:
                    type: string
                  end_date:
                    type: string
              occursAnnually:
                type: boolean
              userIds:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
              userGroupIds:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
              everyoneIncludingNew:
                type: boolean
              automaticTimeEntryCreation:
                type: boolean
              projectId:
                type: string
                nullable: true
              taskId:
                type: string
                nullable: true
endpoints.notes: Actual create + immediate delete. dry_run not supported by this tool. Response confirms date_period object shape, not flat date fields.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: duplicateInvoice
  summary: Duplicate an existing invoice
  x-verification-status: UNCONFIRMED-AGREE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.invoices.duplicate-path-existence.json
  x-notes: |
    GET /invoices/{id}/duplicate returns 405 'Request method GET is not supported',
    confirming the path IS registered in Clockify's routing (Spring-MVC rule: 405 = path present).
    POST could not be confirmed because CLOCKIFY_ENABLE_RAW_WRITES is not set and there is
    no typed MCP tool for this operation. Path presence is confirmed; POST response shape unverified.
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: invoiceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: false
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Duplicated invoice (shape unconfirmed — POST blocked by raw-write guard)
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
endpoints.notes: Path confirmed registered via 405 on GET probe. POST blocked by CLOCKIFY_ENABLE_RAW_WRITES guard. No typed tool for duplicate. UNCONFIRMED-AGREE: both specs agree the path exists and the 405 confirms routing; POST response shape not live-verified.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: getInvoicesInfo
  summary: Bulk paged invoice query with authoritative total
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.invoices.info-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    Tool returned data (not unsupported error). Confirmed LIVE-VERIFIED.
    Returns paged invoice list with authoritative total (121 invoices observed).
    Distinct from clockify_invoices_list: /invoices/info returns an authoritative total count.
    Response items have amount sub-object with amount_cents, amount_decimal, currency, display.
    Accepts statuses filter and page/page_size pagination.
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: false
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            statuses:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
                enum: [UNSENT, SENT, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, VOID, OVERDUE]
            page:
              type: integer
              minimum: 1
            page_size:
              type: integer
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 200
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Paged invoice list with totals
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              data:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    id:
                      type: string
                    number:
                      type: string
                    status:
                      type: string
                    clientId:
                      type: string
                    clientName:
                      type: string
                    issuedDate:
                      type: string
                      format: date-time
                    dueDate:
                      type: string
                      format: date-time
                    currency:
                      type: string
                    amount:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        amount_cents:
                          type: integer
                        amount_decimal:
                          type: string
                        currency:
                          type: string
                        display:
                          type: string
              meta:
                type: object
                properties:
                  count:
                    type: integer
                  has_more:
                    type: boolean
                  page:
                    type: integer
                  pageSize:
                    type: integer
                  total:
                    type: integer
                    description: Authoritative total invoice count for the workspace
endpoints.notes: clockify_invoices_info is a confirmed live tool. Returns authoritative total (121). Read-only, no cleanup needed.
